quests.instruction: Grapes usually grow and are sold together in one big, clustered group. What word describes that group?
quests.question: Bunch
quests.hint: This word describes many small things grouped together, still attached.
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Grapes growing together in one clustered group are described by this word!
quests.funFact: A group of grapes like this can hold over one hundred individual grapes!

quests.instruction: Corn picked from the stalk this afternoon hasn't been canned or frozen. Which word matches?
quests.question: Fresh
quests.hint: This word describes food that hasn't traveled far or waited long.
quests.explanation: Terrific! Corn picked from the stalk this afternoon hasn't waited long, matching this word!
quests.funFact: Some vegetables start losing their flavor within hours of being picked!

quests.instruction: A helping of ice cream is scooped into this round, deep dish for dessert. What's this word?
quests.question: Bowl
quests.hint: This word names the dish, deeper than a dinner plate.
quests.explanation: Yes! A helping of ice cream scooped into this deep dish is named by this word!
quests.funFact: This deep dish shape helps keep melting ice cream from sliding everywhere!

quests.instruction: A lollipop, a donut, and cotton candy are all extra-special, fun foods. What's the word?
quests.question: Treat
quests.hint: This word describes a small reward, not a whole meal.
quests.explanation: That's right! A lollipop, a donut, and cotton candy are all extra-special foods, matching this word!
quests.funFact: Fairs and carnivals are famous for foods like this!

quests.instruction: A whole, uncut piece of sourdough bread sitting on the counter is called this. What's the word?
quests.question: Loaf
quests.hint: This word is used before it's cut into individual slices.
quests.explanation: Great job! A whole, uncut piece of sourdough bread is named by this word before slicing!
quests.funFact: Bread pans come in this long shape so the dough rises just right!

quests.instruction: A tray of ice cubes and a container of sorbet are both kept this way in the freezer. What's the word?
quests.question: Frozen
quests.hint: This word describes food or drinks turned solid by extreme cold.
quests.explanation: You got it! Ice cubes and sorbet are both turned solid by extreme cold, matching this word!
quests.funFact: This kind of extreme cold can keep some foods safe to eat for a whole year!

quests.instruction: A helping of oatmeal is served warm in this deep, round dish. What's the word?
quests.question: Bowl
quests.hint: This word describes the dish, not the food that's inside it.
quests.explanation: Well done! A helping of oatmeal served in this deep, round dish is named by this word!
quests.funFact: This dish comes in sizes from tiny to giant, depending on the meal!

quests.instruction: A bag of frozen berries stays hard and icy until it's time to blend a smoothie. Which word matches?
quests.question: Frozen
quests.hint: This word describes food kept solid until you're ready to use it.
quests.explanation: Correct! A bag of berries stays hard and icy until blending time, matching this word!
quests.funFact: Freezing fruit is a clever way to enjoy summer flavors even in winter!

quests.instruction: Bananas usually grow together in one curved, connected group. Which word fits?
quests.question: Bunch
quests.hint: This word describes fruit that grows attached together in one group.
quests.explanation: Super! Bananas growing together in one connected group are described by this word!
quests.funFact: This whole connected group of bananas is sometimes called a 'hand'!

quests.instruction: Oatmeal, leafy greens, and lean turkey are smart choices to keep your body strong. What's this word?
quests.question: Healthy
quests.hint: This word means chosen with your body's wellbeing in mind.
quests.explanation: Nice work! Oatmeal, leafy greens, and lean turkey are all smart choices for a strong body, matching this word!
quests.funFact: A balanced plate with foods like this helps give your body everything it needs!

quests.instruction: A single wedge cut from a whole pizza pie is called one of these. What's the word?
quests.question: Piece
quests.hint: This word means just one part of something that was once whole.
quests.explanation: You found it! A single wedge cut from a whole pizza is named by this word!
quests.funFact: A whole pizza is often cut into eight of these equal parts!

quests.instruction: Fruit salad is served in this round, deep dish before lunch. Which word fits?
quests.question: Bowl
quests.hint: This is the word for a deep, round dish, not a flat one.
quests.explanation: Exactly right! Fruit salad served in this round, deep dish is named by this word!
quests.funFact: This dish is one of the very first kinds of dishes people ever used!

quests.instruction: Mustard and mayonnaise are often kept in this glass or plastic container in the fridge. Which word matches?
quests.question: Jar
quests.hint: This word names a container that's usually taller than it is wide.
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Mustard and mayonnaise are kept in this tall container, named by this word!
quests.funFact: This container's tight lid helps keep food fresh and air out!

quests.instruction: A single slice of cake cut from the whole dessert is called one of these. What's this word?
quests.question: Piece
quests.hint: This word means one single part taken from something whole.
quests.explanation: Terrific! A single slice of cake taken from the whole dessert is named by this word!
quests.funFact: Cutting a whole cake this way lets everyone get a fair, equal share!

quests.instruction: A pack of frozen waffles and a bag of ice are both kept solid in the freezer. Which word fits?
quests.question: Frozen
quests.hint: This word describes the coldest, hardest state a food can be stored in.
quests.explanation: Yes! Frozen waffles and a bag of ice are both kept solid in the freezer, matching this word!
quests.funFact: This method of keeping food is one of the best ways to stop it from spoiling!

quests.instruction: Banana bread comes out of the oven as one big, whole piece before it's cut. Which word fits?
quests.question: Loaf
quests.hint: This is the word for one whole block of baked bread.
quests.explanation: That's right! Banana bread out of the oven as one whole block is named by this word!
quests.funFact: This whole shape needs to cool down before it's easy to slice neatly!

quests.instruction: A single square cut from a whole pan of cornbread is called one of these. Which word fits?
quests.question: Piece
quests.hint: This word means a single portion, not the entire dish.
quests.explanation: Great job! A single square cut from a whole pan of cornbread is named by this word!
quests.funFact: This word can describe just one small portion of almost any food!

quests.instruction: Strawberries picked from the field this morning haven't been frozen or canned. Which word fits?
quests.question: Fresh
quests.hint: This word is the opposite of food kept in a freezer for months.
quests.explanation: You got it! Strawberries picked this morning haven't been frozen or canned, matching this word!
quests.funFact: Farmers markets are a great place to find food like this!

quests.instruction: A tomato just picked from the garden hasn't been frozen, canned, or cooked yet. What word describes it?
quests.question: Fresh
quests.hint: This word describes food that's new, not stored away for a long time.
quests.explanation: Well done! A tomato just picked from the garden hasn't been stored away, matching this word!
quests.funFact: Food like this often has the most vitamins right after it's picked!

quests.instruction: One chunk broken off from a whole chocolate bar is called one of these. Which word matches?
quests.question: Piece
quests.hint: This word describes a single portion broken or cut from a bigger whole.
quests.explanation: Correct! One chunk broken off from a whole chocolate bar is named by this word!
quests.funFact: Chocolate bars are often scored with lines to make breaking off one of these easier!

quests.instruction: A birthday cupcake, a candy cane, and a scoop of sherbet are all special, fun foods. Which word fits?
quests.question: Treat
quests.hint: This word describes a small, sweet reward for a special occasion.
quests.explanation: Super! A birthday cupcake, a candy cane, and sherbet are all special fun foods, matching this word!
quests.funFact: This kind of food often shows up most at parties and celebrations!

quests.instruction: Pumpkin bread is baked in one long pan, coming out as a single whole shape. Which word matches?
quests.question: Loaf
quests.hint: This word describes bread before a knife has touched it.
quests.explanation: Nice work! Pumpkin bread baked as one long, whole shape is named by this word!
quests.funFact: This whole shape of bread can be sliced thick or thin, depending on what you like!

quests.instruction: A serving of rice and a serving of yogurt are both scooped into this round, deep dish. Which word fits?
quests.question: Bowl
quests.hint: This is the round dish you'd use for something with a little liquid.
quests.explanation: You found it! Rice and yogurt are both scooped into this round, deep dish, named by this word!
quests.funFact: This dish is shaped deep and round so foods like soup won't spill!

quests.instruction: Whole wheat pasta, roasted vegetables, and fresh fruit are great everyday choices. Which word fits?
quests.question: Healthy
quests.hint: This word describes food that helps you grow, not just food that tastes sweet.
quests.explanation: Exactly right! Whole wheat pasta, roasted vegetables, and fresh fruit are all great everyday choices, matching this word!
quests.funFact: Your body uses food like this to build strong bones and muscles!

quests.instruction: Honey and jam are both stored in this glass container with a lid. What's this word?
quests.question: Jar
quests.hint: This word names a glass container, usually with a screw-on lid.
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Honey and jam are both stored in this glass, lidded container, named by this word!
quests.funFact: This glass container was one of the earliest ways people learned to store food!

quests.instruction: Cilantro is often sold gathered together in one small, leafy group at the market. Which word fits?
quests.question: Bunch
quests.hint: This word names a small cluster of the same food, held together.
quests.explanation: Terrific! Cilantro gathered together in one leafy cluster is described by this word!
quests.funFact: Herbs sold this way often get placed in a cup of water to stay fresh longer!

quests.instruction: Chili and salad are both served in this round, deep dish at dinner. Which word matches?
quests.question: Bowl
quests.hint: This dish has higher sides than a flat plate.
quests.explanation: Yes! Chili and salad served in this round, deep dish with high sides are named by this word!
quests.funFact: This dish's deep shape makes it perfect for foods with sauce or broth!

quests.instruction: Radishes at the farmers market are often sold together in one small, tied group. Which word matches?
quests.question: Bunch
quests.hint: This word describes several of the same food grouped as one unit.
quests.explanation: That's right! Radishes sold together in one tied group are described by this word!
quests.funFact: Selling food this way makes it quick to grab a whole group at once!

quests.instruction: Hot chocolate on a cold day is often served warm in this small container. What's this word?
quests.question: Cup
quests.hint: This word names the small container you'd wrap both hands around to stay warm.
quests.explanation: Great job! Hot chocolate on a cold day is served in this small warm container, named by this word!
quests.funFact: This container's handle helps keep your fingers from touching the hot sides!

quests.instruction: Soup and cereal are both served in a round, deep dish for eating with a spoon. What's this word?
quests.question: Bowl
quests.hint: This word names the round, deep dish soup is served in.
quests.explanation: You got it! Soup and cereal are both served in a round, deep dish, named by this word!
quests.funFact: This round dish keeps warm foods like soup from spilling over the sides!
